mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_album a WHERE a.photo_count <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id = a.id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_album WHERE identity_key = ''
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT dir_key, identity_key FROM media_album GROUP BY dir_key, identity_key HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ) t
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_photo WHERE missing = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_video WHERE missing = 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_album a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id = a.id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_album a WHERE a.id = p.album_id)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_album WHERE cover_path IS NULL OR cover_path = ''
SELECT a.id AS id, a.dir_key AS dirKey, a.title AS title FROM media_album a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id = a.id) ORDER BY a.id
SELECT a.id AS id, a.dir_key AS dirKey, a.title AS title FROM media_album a ORDER BY a.id

SELECT a.id AS id, a.title AS title, a.photo_count AS declared, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id = a.id) AS actual FROM media_album a WHERE a.photo_count <> (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_photo p WHERE p.album_id = a.id) ORDER BY a.photo_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT path FROM media_root WHERE kind = 'root' ORDER BY id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM media_album_person WHERE album_id IN #{id}
DELETE FROM media_album WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE media_person SET avatar_path = NULL, avatar_kind = NULL, avatar_ref = NULL WHERE avatar_ref IS NOT NULL AND avatar_ref <> '' AND SUBSTRING_INDEX(avatar_ref, ':', 1) IN #{id}

UPDATE media_album a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT album_id, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(bytes) AS b FROM media_photo GROUP BY album_id ) t ON t.album_id = a.id SET a.photo_count = COALESCE(t.c, 0), a.bytes = COALESCE(t.b, 0) WHERE a.photo_count <> COALESCE(t.c, 0) OR a.bytes <> COALESCE(t.b, 0)
